name: groundplan
description: Cross-platform editor for legacy Room Viewer event floor plans — runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux
author: Prince Thompson

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run build
scripts.dist: npm run build:starter-inventory && npm run build:dmg-background && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:starter-inventory && npm run build:dmg-background && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:starter-inventory && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:starter-inventory && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run build:starter-inventory && npm run build:dmg-background && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --win --linux --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:starter-inventory && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config.directories.output=release-smoke
scripts.test: tsx tools/catalog-test.ts && tsx tools/hermetic-test.ts && tsx tools/spotlight-xml-test.ts && tsx tools/spotlight-xml-stress-test.ts && tsx tools/placement-fidelity-test.ts && tsx tools/apply-layout-orchestrator-test.ts && tsx tools/layout-recipe-scale-test.ts && tsx tools/layout-recipe-replace-test.ts && tsx tools/gear-inventory-safety-test.ts && tsx tools/gear-symbol-test.ts && tsx tools/inventory-share-test.ts && tsx tools/inventory-stress-test.ts && tsx tools/feature-stress-test.ts && tsx tools/inventory-seed-test.ts && tsx tools/app-update-prompt-test.ts && tsx tools/rollback-test.ts && tsx tools/synthesize-test.ts && tsx tools/room-test.ts && tsx tools/definition-test.ts && tsx tools/room-authoring-test.ts && tsx tools/curve-test.ts && tsx tools/dimension-test.ts && tsx tools/tool-machine-test.ts && tsx tools/workspace-test.ts && tsx tools/transform-handles-test.ts && tsx tools/oriented-extent-test.ts && tsx tools/mcp-plan-tools-test.ts && tsx tools/seating-plan-test.ts && tsx tools/seating-options-test.ts && tsx tools/stage-av-test.ts && tsx tools/report-test.ts && tsx tools/export-scale-test.ts && tsx tools/snap-test.ts && tsx tools/layers-test.ts && tsx tools/cable-test.ts && tsx tools/led-test.ts && tsx tools/versions-test.ts && tsx tools/polygon-boolean-test.ts && tsx tools/overlap-test.ts && tsx tools/show-brief-test.ts && tsx tools/plan-model-test.ts && tsx tools/room-viewer-parity-test.ts && tsx tools/usb-update-test.ts && tsx tools/edit-test.ts --fixture
scripts.dist:mac:signed: npm run build:starter-inventory && npm run build:dmg-background && npm run build && GROUNDPLAN_SIGNED=1 electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.signed.yml --publish never
